text:
You need a detail-oriented data analyst/statistician who can evaluate sporting data, model outcomes, and turn that analysis into reliable predictions for betting odds.  

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I can help analyze player and team statistics, performance data, and other relevant sources, then build statistical models to estimate outcome probabilities and support data-driven decisions. I’m comfortable working with messy data, comparing multiple signals, and presenting clear insights to stakeholders.  

I’m interested in the trial basis and would approach it with a focus on accuracy, consistency, and communication. What sports and data sources will I be working with first?
